Apply understanding and experience with global wine styles and demonstrate the ability to discern wine quality, style, and value.

programs.title: Women's Studies
outcomes: Analyze gender as a social category that influences identity formation and institutional configurations.
Assess how intersections of gender, sexuality, race, ethnicity, class, and other dimensions of social life impact power dynamics.
Examine and critique ideological assumptions underlying cultural representation and social practices.
Formulate effective and convincing oral and written arguments employing conventions appropriate to the field.

programs.title: WordPress Web Design and Development
outcomes: Demonstrate creative problem solving using the graphic design process in WordPress.
Create and publish a website using WordPress.

programs.title: Working with Culturally Diverse Families
programs.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units
outcomes: Integrate principles of cultural and linguistic competency, inclusive practices, and anti-bias education in teaching and caring for young children and working with their families.
